title: Getting things done
focus: 计划 · 进展 · 调整 · 检查 · 优先 · 搞定 · 拖延 · 按时
body:
# Getting things done

Words for moving work along: making a plan, adjusting it, checking it and getting it done on time. You hear them every day in any office.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 计划 | jìhuà | plan (noun: a formal, detailed plan) | calculate + mark out → plan |
| 进展 | jìnzhǎn | progress / developments (on a matter) | advance + unfold → progress |
| 调整 | tiáozhěng | to adjust | tune it back into order |
| 检查 | jiǎnchá | to check / inspect (for mistakes or problems) | examine + look into → check |
| 优先 | yōuxiān | to give priority to / do first | ranks higher, so goes first |
| 搞定 | gǎodìng | to get it done / sort it out (colloquial) | work on it till settled |
| 拖延 | tuōyán | to procrastinate / drag things out | drag + stretch out → procrastinate |
| 按时 | ànshí | on time (by the scheduled date) | according to the set time |

## Which word?

**计划 vs 打算**: 计划 is a concrete plan; 打算 is a looser intention (我打算明年换工作).

**按时 vs 准时**: 按时 = by the scheduled date (按时交); 准时 = punctual, at the exact minute (准时到).

## Sentences

- 项目进展太慢，客户已经有意见了。 xiàngmù jìnzhǎn tài màn, kèhù yǐjīng yǒu yìjiàn le: The project is moving too slowly. The client is already unhappy.
- 预算不够了，计划得调整一下。 yùsuàn bú gòu le, jìhuà děi tiáozhěng yíxià: The budget's run short, so the plan needs adjusting.
- 别再拖延了，截止日期就是明天。 bié zài tuōyán le, jiézhǐ rìqī jiù shì míngtiān: Stop putting it off. The deadline is tomorrow.
- 调整完以后，你再检查一遍。 tiáozhěng wán yǐhòu, nǐ zài jiǎnchá yí biàn: Once you've adjusted it, check it over one more time.
- 我们优先搞定这个，别的可以推迟。 wǒmen yōuxiān gǎodìng zhège, bié de kěyǐ tuīchí: Let's get this one done first. The rest can be pushed back.
- 要是再拖延，就来不及按时交了。 yàoshi zài tuōyán, jiù láibují ànshí jiāo le: If you drag it out any longer, you won't be able to hand it in on time.
- 这事我负责，保证按时搞定。 zhè shì wǒ fùzé, bǎozhèng ànshí gǎodìng: I'm in charge of this. I promise it'll be done on time.
- 每周五要跟领导汇报进展。 měi zhōu wǔ yào gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào jìnzhǎn: Every Friday we have to report our progress to the boss.

cards.Example: 计划赶不上变化。 jìhuà gǎn bu shàng biànhuà: Plans can never keep up with changes
cards.Notes: 计 jì count, calculate, 讠 (计算, 设计) + 划 huà mark out, 刂 knife (规划) = calculate and mark out. 计划 is a concrete plan; 打算 (算 = reckon) is a looser intention, more spoken

cards.Example: 那个项目有什么进展吗？ nàge xiàngmù yǒu shénme jìnzhǎn ma: Any progress on that project?
cards.Notes: 进 jìn advance (进来, 进步) + 展 zhǎn unfold (展开, 发展) = moving forward and unfolding. 进展 = how a matter is moving; 进步 = advance a 步 step, a person improving

cards.Example: 时间可能要调整一下。 shíjiān kěnéng yào tiáozhěng yíxià: We may need to adjust the timing
cards.Notes: 调 tiáo tune (空调) + 整 zhěng whole, in order (整齐, 整理) = tune it back into order. 调 is tiáo here, not diào as in 调查. Same 调 as 协调

cards.English: to check / inspect (for mistakes or problems)
cards.Example: 交之前再检查一遍。 jiāo zhīqián zài jiǎnchá yí biàn: Check it once more before you hand it in
cards.Notes: 检 jiǎn examine (体检, 检验) + 查 chá look into (查字典, 调查) = examine and look into. Also a medical checkup: 去医院检查

cards.English: to give priority to / do first
cards.Example: 客户的问题要优先处理。 kèhù de wèntí yào yōuxiān chǔlǐ: Customer issues get handled first
cards.Notes: 优 yōu excellent, superior (优秀, 优点) + 先 xiān first (先生, 首先) = goes first because it ranks higher. 优先级 = priority level; 首先 = first of all (in a sequence of points)

cards.English: to get it done / sort it out (colloquial)
cards.Example: 放心，明天之前肯定搞定。 fàngxīn, míngtiān zhīqián kěndìng gǎodìng: Don't worry, it'll definitely be done before tomorrow
cards.Notes: 搞 gǎo do, get, 扌 hand (搞错, 搞笑) + 定 dìng settled (决定, 一定) = work on it till it's settled. Casual; also works for people: 老板搞定了 = the boss is on board

cards.Example: 他总是拖延，最后一天才开始写。 tā zǒngshì tuōyán, zuìhòu yì tiān cái kāishǐ xiě: He always procrastinates and only starts writing on the last day
cards.Notes: 拖 tuō drag, 扌 hand (拖地) + 延 yán stretch, extend (延长, 延期) = drag it and stretch it out. 拖延症 = chronic procrastination; spoken: 别拖了

cards.Example: 这些活儿能按时做完吗？ zhèxiē huór néng ànshí zuòwán ma: Can this work be finished on time?
cards.Notes: 按 àn press, according to, 扌 hand (按钮, 按照) + 时 shí time = according to the set time. 按时 = by the scheduled time; 准时 = 准 accurate + 时: punctual, at the exact moment

cards.English: The project is moving too slowly. The client is already unhappy.
cards.Hanzi: 项目进展太慢，客户已经有意见了。
cards.Pinyin: xiàngmù jìnzhǎn tài màn, kèhù yǐjīng yǒu yìjiàn le.
cards.Notes: 进展 (L10) + 项目 (L6) + 客户 (L6) + 意见 (L3). 有意见 = have a complaint, not just 'have an opinion'.

cards.English: The budget's run short, so the plan needs adjusting.
cards.Hanzi: 预算不够了，计划得调整一下。
cards.Pinyin: yùsuàn bú gòu le, jìhuà děi tiáozhěng yíxià.
cards.Notes: 计划 (L10) + 调整 (L10) + 预算 (L9). 调 is tiáo here, not diào.

cards.English: Stop putting it off. The deadline is tomorrow.
cards.Hanzi: 别再拖延了，截止日期就是明天。
cards.Pinyin: bié zài tuōyán le, jiézhǐ rìqī jiù shì míngtiān.
cards.Notes: 拖延 (L10) + 截止日期 (L6). Spoken short form: 别拖了.

cards.English: Once you've adjusted it, check it over one more time.
cards.Hanzi: 调整完以后，你再检查一遍。
cards.Pinyin: tiáozhěng wán yǐhòu, nǐ zài jiǎnchá yí biàn.
cards.Notes: 调整 (L10) + 检查 (L10). 一遍 = one time through, from start to finish.

cards.English: Let's get this one done first. The rest can be pushed back.
cards.Hanzi: 我们优先搞定这个，别的可以推迟。
cards.Pinyin: wǒmen yōuxiān gǎodìng zhège, bié de kěyǐ tuīchí.
cards.Notes: 优先 (L10) + 搞定 (L10) + 推迟 (L5). 优先 can sit right before the verb: 优先处理, 优先搞定.

cards.English: If you drag it out any longer, you won't be able to hand it in on time.
cards.Hanzi: 要是再拖延，就来不及按时交了。
cards.Pinyin: yàoshi zài tuōyán, jiù láibují ànshí jiāo le.
cards.Notes: 拖延 (L10) + 按时 (L10) + 来不及 (L5). 要是……就…… = if ... then ...

cards.English: I'm in charge of this. I promise it'll be done on time.
cards.Hanzi: 这事我负责，保证按时搞定。
cards.Pinyin: zhè shì wǒ fùzé, bǎozhèng ànshí gǎodìng.
cards.Notes: 搞定 (L10) + 按时 (L10) + 负责 (L4). 搞定 is casual; formal is 完成.

cards.English: Every Friday we have to report our progress to the boss.
cards.Hanzi: 每周五要跟领导汇报进展。
cards.Pinyin: měi zhōu wǔ yào gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào jìnzhǎn.
cards.Notes: 进展 (L10) + 领导 (L6) + 汇报 (L6). 进展 is how a matter moves; 进步 is a person improving.
